body: AMEND on the proposed costWeights accessor. LocalCostModel.costWeights is an implementation declaration, not evidence that cost used those weights; an arbitrary implementation can return basis A and compute with B. The exact attack court should define such a model and require GraphHsmm.infer to refuse it. The contained truthful contract is an explicit SupportBasis or DeclaredCostWeights value supplied once to the GraphHsmm invocation and passed into every fallible cost/externalCost call; each returned CostBreakdown is rebuilt or validated against that same basis, and HsmmResult stores exactly that restricted basis. The v4 decoder may compare against an expected basis only when the expectation is derived from an independently admitted invocation receipt. If both wire basis and expected argument are caller-controlled, the decoder proves internal consistency only. Name that narrower entitlement rather than actual invocation provenance. If chief authorizes only support-share accounting, this closes the c538 support attack; full cost-model identity/execution provenance remains a separate receipt problem.
